notes: Track of Meitav's investment provident fund "מיטב גמל להשקעה", fund (קופה) number 7857 (flyer p.3; merger notice). Old name(s) until 30.6.2024, same track number (flyer p.3, CAT-13, CAT-26): מיטב גמל להשקעה מסלול פאסיבי - כללי. The old name's "כללי" meant a passive general mix, not the general track 7978 (CAT-26, CAT-28). Listed under the page's group "מסלולים כללים". Meitav announced a policy change for this track from 1.7.2026 (CAT-24).
